about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Soboro Don Three-Colour Mince and Egg Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Sweet soy-glazed chicken mince and fluffy scrambled egg over steamed rice with blanched greens.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm. Blanch the beans in boiling water for 3 minutes until bright green and just tender, then slice.
Simmer the chicken with 2 tbsp soy sauce, mirin, 2 teaspoons of the sugar and the ginger over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring with chopsticks until the liquid is gone.
Beat the eggs with the remaining soy sauce and sugar and scramble in the neutral oil over low heat for 3 minutes until fine and fluffy.
Divide the rice between bowls and arrange the chicken, egg and beans in neat sections.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken mince until it reaches 75°C with no pink, and the eggs until set. Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Yakiniku Don Japanese Beef Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Quick-seared beef strips glazed in sweet soy and garlic, served over rice with spring onion and a soft egg.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm. Stir the garlic, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sesame oil together.
Heat the neutral oil in a frying pan over high heat and sear the beef in two batches for 1 1/2 minutes each until browned.
Return all the beef, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until sticky and glossy.
Spoon over bowls of rice, top with a yolk and the spring onions and finish with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until no pink remains; the egg yolks are served soft, so skip them for young children, older adults or anyone pregnant. Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame; check the thickest part reaches 75°C.

recipes.title: Kimchi Bokkeumbap Pork Belly Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Sharp, spicy Korean fried rice with kimchi, pork belly and a fried egg on top.
steps: Fry the pork belly in a hot wok for 6 minutes until the fat renders and the edges are crisp.
Add the kimchi and cook for 3 minutes until the edges caramelise, then stir in the gochujang and kimchi juice.
Add the cold rice, break it up and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp, then add the soy sauce and half the sesame oil.
Fry the eggs in the neutral oil for 2 minutes until the whites are set and crisp at the edge.
Serve the rice topped with an egg, spring onions, sesame seeds and the rest of the sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork belly until it reaches 75°C and the eggs until the whites are set; use rice cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour and eaten within a day. Contains egg, gluten, soy, sesame, fish and shellfish.

recipes.title: Dakbokkeumtang Braised Chicken and Potato
recipes.summary: Korean chilli chicken braised with potato and carrot until the sauce is thick, sweet and fiery.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil into a paste.
Put the chicken, potato, carrot and onion in a wide pot, stir in the paste and water and bring to the boil until bubbling.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, then uncover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potato is tender and the sauce thick and glossy.
Scatter over spring onions and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Dubu Jorim Braised Tofu in Spicy Soy
recipes.summary: Pan-fried tofu simmered in a garlicky gochugaru-soy sauce, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Pat the tofu dry with paper towel.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side until golden, then arrange in a flat pan.
Mix the soy sauce, gochugaru, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, spring onions and water and spoon over the tofu.
Simmer on low for 8 minutes, spooning the sauce over, until the liquid has reduced and the tofu is glossy.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with the rice.
notes: Vegan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Mala Xiang Guo Dry Pot Chicken and Vegetables
recipes.summary: Sichuan dry pot of chicken, mushrooms, lotus-style potato and greens, wok-fried with numbing and chilli spices.

items: 600g chicken thigh, boneless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Fry the potato batons in 2 tbsp of the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then set aside.
In the same wok fry the dried chillies and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the ginger, garlic and chilli bean paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 6 minutes until cooked through, then add the mushrooms, broccoli, soy sauce, sugar and water.
Cook for 4 minutes until the broccoli is just tender, return the potato and toss for 1 minute.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Yu Xiang Rou Si Fish-Fragrant Shredded Pork
recipes.summary: Sichuan stir-fry of shredded pork, capsicum and wood ear mushroom in a sweet, sour and spicy sauce.

items: 500g pork loin, cut into thin strips

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Toss the pork with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornflour.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 2 minutes until it turns opaque. Add the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the capsicums and wood ear and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then pour in the sauce and toss until glossy and the pork is cooked through.
Scatter over spring onions and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw pork.

recipes.title: Dongpo Pork Red-Braised Pork Belly
recipes.summary: Square-cut pork belly slow-braised in Shaoxing wine, soy and rock sugar until it melts at the touch of a spoon.
steps: Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse to remove scum.
Line a heavy pot with the ginger and spring onions, sit the pork on top skin side down and add the wine, both soy sauces, sugar and water.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 2 hours, turning the pork once, until a skewer slides in with no resistance.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blanch the bok choy for 2 minutes until just tender.
Boil the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes until sticky and glossy and serve over rice with the greens.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C throughout and is meltingly tender, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Beef Chow Fun Wok-Fried Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: Silky wide rice noodles seared in a hot wok with sliced beef, bean sprouts and spring onion in soy.
steps: Separate the noodles gently and toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the wine. Mix the remaining soy sauces, oyster sauce and sugar.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over very high heat and sear the beef for 1 1/2 minutes until browned. Remove.
Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then the noodles and sauce and toss for 3 minutes until the noodles take on colour and char slightly.
Return the beef with the sprouts and spring onions and toss for 1 minute until the sprouts just wilt.
Serve straight from the wok.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until browned and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw beef; check the thickest part reaches 75°C. Cool any leftover noodles and cooked rice and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salt and Pepper Tofu Crisp Wok-Tossed Cubes
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged tofu tossed with garlic, chilli and white pepper, served over rice with sauteed greens.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Pat the tofu very dry and toss gently in the cornflour.
Shallow-fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towel.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp oil, fry the garlic, chillies and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the salt, white pepper and Sichuan pepper.
Return the tofu and toss for 1 minute until coated.
Stir-fry the bok choy with the soy sauce for 2 minutes until just tender and serve alongside the tofu and rice.
notes: Vegan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Hakka Yong Tau Foo Stuffed Tofu with Prawn Filling
recipes.summary: Hakka tofu puffs and capsicum stuffed with a prawn and pork filling, pan-fried then braised in a light soy sauce.

items: 300g raw prawns, peeled and finely chopped

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the prawns, pork, spring onions, cornflour, ginger, sesame oil and pepper into a sticky paste.
Cut a pocket into each tofu puff and press in a spoonful of filling, smoothing the top.
Pan-fry the stuffed puffs filling side down in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until golden.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce and stock, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the filling is firm and cooked through.
Uncover and boil for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the filling until the prawns are opaque, firm throughout and the pork reaches 75°C, and wash hands after handling raw pork and prawns. Contains shellfish, gluten, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Mee Siam Goreng Spicy Tamarind Vermicelli
recipes.summary: Stir-fried vermicelli in a sweet, sour and spicy tamarind sauce with prawns, tofu puffs, egg and chives.

items: 1 bunch garlic chives, cut in 4cm lengths

steps: Soak the vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Mix the chilli paste, tamarind, sugar and fish sauce with 1/2 cup water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Add the tofu puffs and sauce, then the vermicelli, and toss for 3 minutes until the noodles absorb the sauce.
Push aside, scramble in the eggs for 1 minute, then fold through the sprouts and chives.
Serve hot with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the eggs until set, with the noodles steaming hot at 75°C. Contains egg, shellfish, soy and fish.

recipes.title: Pepes Ikan Banana Leaf Steamed Fish with Spices
recipes.summary: Fish fillets covered in a turmeric, lemongrass and chilli paste and steamed in parcels, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blend the shallots, garlic, chillies, turmeric, lemongrass, tamarind, fish sauce and oil to a coarse paste.
Coat the fish in the paste, then place each fillet on a sheet of baking paper with tomato and basil and fold into a sealed parcel.
Steam the parcels over simmering water for 15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Open the parcels and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C in the thickest part, and keep raw fish chilled until cooking.

recipes.title: Goong Pad Pong Karee Thai Curry Powder Prawns
recipes.summary: Prawns and egg stir-fried in a creamy yellow curry sauce with capsicum and celery, served with jasmine rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the curry powder, coconut milk, stock, oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, fry the garlic and onion for 2 minutes, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Pour in the sauce, add the capsicum and celery and simmer for 3 minutes.
Drizzle in the eggs in a thin stream and stir gently for 2 minutes until just set and creamy.
Fold through the spring onions and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the eggs until set, with the sauce steaming hot at 75°C. Contains egg, shellfish, gluten and fish. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Com Chien Duong Chau Yangzhou Fried Rice Vietnamese Style
recipes.summary: Colourful fried rice with prawns, Chinese sausage, egg, peas and carrot.
steps: Fry the sausage in 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and carrot and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the eggs and scramble for 1 minute until just set.
Add the cold rice and toss for 3 minutes until hot, breaking up any clumps.
Return the prawns and sausage with the peas, fish sauce, soy sauce and pepper and toss for 2 minutes until steaming hot.
Fold through the spring onions and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the rice steaming hot at 75°C; use cooked rice cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour and eaten within a day. Contains egg, shellfish, gluten, soy and fish.

recipes.title: Kaldereta Filipino Spicy Beef Stew
recipes.summary: Beef braised in tomato sauce with liver spread, capsicum, potato and olives until rich and tender.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 8 minutes total, then fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes in the same pot.
Add the passata, tomato paste, stock, chillies and bay leaves, cover and simmer for 1 hour 20 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potato and carrot and cook for 20 minutes until soft, then stir in the capsicum, olives and pate and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until fork-tender and well above 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Afritada Tomato Braised Chicken
recipes.summary: Filipino chicken braised with potato, carrot and capsicum in a light tomato sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onion and garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes, then add the passata, stock, fish sauce and bay leaf and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, add the potato and carrot and cook for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the capsicum and peas for 4 minutes and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Dum Aloo Kashmiri Style Potato Curry
recipes.summary: Baby potatoes fried until crisp and slow-cooked in a spiced yoghurt and fennel gravy.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until nearly tender, drain, prick with a fork and fry in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Whisk the yoghurt with the fennel, ginger, cardamom, chilli, turmeric and salt.
Fry the onions and garlic in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until golden, then reduce the heat and stir in the yoghurt mix.
Add the potatoes and 1/2 cup water, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the gravy is thick and the potatoes tender.
Stir in the garam masala and serve with the rice.
notes: Vegetarian. Dinner. Contains dairy.

recipes.title: Methi Malai Paneer with Rice
recipes.summary: Soft paneer in a creamy fenugreek and cashew gravy, served with basmati rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blend the cashews with 1/2 cup water to a smooth paste.
Fry the onions in the ghee for 6 minutes until pale gold, add the ginger, garlic, chillies and cumin for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cashew paste, milk and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 6 minutes until thick.
Add the paneer, fenugreek, cream and salt and cook gently for 5 minutes until the paneer is hot and the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle with garam masala and serve with the rice.
notes: Vegetarian. Dinner. Contains dairy and cashews.

recipes.title: Kabuli Pulao Afghan Lamb and Carrot Rice
recipes.summary: Afghan-style rice with tender lamb, caramelised carrot and raisins scented with cardamom and cumin.
steps: Brown the lamb with the onions in half the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, add the cumin, cardamom, salt and 3 cups water, cover and simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
Fry the carrot with the sugar in the remaining oil for 6 minutes until caramelised and add the raisins for 1 minute.
Lift the lamb out, measure the stock to 3 cups and add the soaked rice, then lay the lamb on top. Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fold through half the carrot and raisin mix, top with the rest and the almonds and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until fork-tender and well above 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours. Contains nuts.

recipes.title: Chicken Muamba Gabonese-Style Palm Butter Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in a rich palm butter and tomato sauce with okra, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Brown the chicken in the palm oil for 8 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onions and garlic for 4 minutes in the same pot, add the tomatoes and chilli and cook for 6 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the peanut butter and stock, return the chicken and simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Add the okra and salt and cook for 8 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains peanuts.

recipes.title: Wali wa Maharage Kenyan Beans in Coconut with Rice
recipes.summary: Red kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with tomato, onion and spices, served over fluffy rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, add the garlic, curry powder and turmeric for 1 minute, then the tomatoes for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the beans, coconut milk, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans are creamy.
Scatter with coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Vegan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Thieboudienne Senegalese Fish and Tomato Rice
recipes.summary: Senegal's red rice cooked in a tomato and fish broth with white fish and vegetables.
steps: Mix half the garlic with the chilli, a pinch of salt and press this into the fish, then sear the fish in the oil for 2 minutes each side. Remove.
Fry the onions in the same pot for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste and tomatoes for 5 minutes, then the water and fish sauce and bring to the boil.
Add the carrots, eggplant and cabbage and simmer for 20 minutes until tender, then lift out the vegetables and keep warm.
Add the rice to the broth, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed, then return the fish for the last 5 minutes until opaque.
Serve the rice with the fish and vegetables on top.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C in the thickest part, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.
